issue: Home-field advantage is declared at 0.0 points.
handling: Carried as a declared parameter on Validation gates; not estimated from this sample.

issue: 13 of 14 Week 10 games had no settled close at capture.
handling: Stored as close_status=not_final with the live quote in the close column; never graded as a close.

issue: Zero strategies are certified; leaderboard.csv is empty by design.
handling: Published as a stated result with the failing gates named on every row.

issue: The overtime flag is blank on all 137 games.
handling: Official week pages state score and day, not overtime. Left blank rather than inferred.

issue: Margin dispersion sigma = 13.86 is a published league value, not fitted here.
handling: Declared on Validation gates with the reason no re-estimation was attempted.

issue: Total dispersion sigma = 13.5 is declared, not measured.
handling: Same handling as F4-F05.

issue: Injury-report rosters name players at clubs that differ from 2025.
handling: Recorded exactly as published (Kyler Murray, MIN; Mike Evans, SF; Justin Fields, KC); not corrected, not smoothed.

issue: Both depth charts read are unofficial by the publisher's own words.
handling: Every depth row carries status=verified_unofficial_source plus the club caveat text.

issue: The DraftKings league page returns no numbers to a static read.
handling: Prices were taken from the operator's odds payload instead; recorded here so the failed route is not mistaken for missing data.

issue: Deficiency weights (0.00 / 0.35 / 0.70 / 0.70) are declared, not fitted.
handling: Monotone in string number; published with the scale so they can be overruled.

issue: 30 of 32 clubs have no depth chart in this pack.
handling: Only clubs whose published chart was read are populated. A jersey-ordered roster is not a depth chart, so the rest are absent rather than guessed.

issue: Rest differential could not be computed.
handling: Published as uncomputable with the reason; no proxy substituted.

issue: Depth-deficiency correlation could not be computed.
handling: One week of snapshots for two clubs is below any usable n.

issue: scripts/source_coverage.py does not allowlist any NFL domain.
handling: NFL rows report secondary_reference_only in that shared tool. A request is logged in COORDINATION.md rather than editing another session's script.

issue: Week 10 has one result because 13 games had not been played.
handling: Stated on the results page; the feed is built to accept the rest as they settle.

issue: Only DraftKings supplies an open/close pair for all 14 games.
handling: FanDuel numbers are a separate provider column and are never averaged in.

issue: A staking score exists for at most two settled bets.
handling: Published with the luck p-value beside it; the mask test says the absence of a masking case is a small-sample artefact.

issue: Player-prop combos (S7) are blocked.
handling: No official player-level stat lines were captured. Blocked at gate G5 rather than priced from a plausible assumption.

issue: Prior pack nfl_309921cc differs from today's official injury page on 3 of 24 NE+DET rows.
handling: Listed on Repo review with the exact fields; the prior file is not modified.

issue: Fair lines are a naive points-per-game rating with no opponent adjustment.
handling: Stated in the method paragraph and on Own lines; every row is model_output, never verified.
